sampled.title: 台中市都市土地使用強度「區位特性」之研究－以容積移轉制度為例.pdf

terminus.finding: The paper gives a useful partial counterexample to the current access-regime candidate. It treats location, carrying capacity, transport, land-use intensity and spatial concentration as causally consequential, not merely as labels assigned by rules. Yet the same paper also argues that TDR design and the absence of location-guidance rules shape where those pressures accumulate. The earlier candidate was therefore too one-sided.
terminus.candidateRevision: Do not frame the recurring structure as 'rules determine what you can do more than position does'. A narrower candidate is that effects are co-produced by access/regulatory regimes and the material-spatial capacities of locations; changing either side changes the outcome.
terminus.next: seek a cleaner case where distance/physical position remains decisive even when formal access rules are held constant
